title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Emeka Egbuka disappoints in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka hauled in just two of his five targets for 18 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
items.impact: Egbuka has struggled to make a consistent impact in the Tampa Bay passing attack, finishing under 50 receiving yards in each of his last five games. The wideout remains one of many risky pass-catching options for head coach Todd Bowles ahead of a Week 12 matchup against the Carolina Panthers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kenny Gainwell sees eight touches in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell rushed four times for 16 yards while also catching four of his five targets for 43 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 Week 11 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Gainwell has offered steady output out of the Tampa Bay backfield of late, recording over 55 offensive yards in each of his last four games. The running back offers more value in PPR formats, with a Week 12 contest against the Carolina Panthers up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Panthers D/ST allows 33 points in Week 11 win
items.desc: The Panthers D/ST allowed 276 passing yards, 157 rushing yards, and 33 points in a 35-33 win over the Panthers.
items.impact: The Panthers' defense tallied two sacks, one interception, and three fumble recoveries in the win Sunday. They will have a tough matchup with Tampa Bay in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ryan Fitzgerald perfect in Week 11 win
items.desc: Ryan Fitzgerald connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: Fitzgerald connected on field goals from 33 and 37 yards out to help pace the Panthers to their fifth win of the season. Fitzgerald and the Panthers will take on Tampa Bay in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chris Godwin Jr. quiet in Week 11
items.desc: Chris Godwin Jr. caught all three of his targets for 13 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
items.impact: Godwin Jr. continues a disappointing season in the Tampa Bay offense, finishing under 50 receiving yards in all 10 of his contests. The veteran wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Carolina Panthers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mitchell Evans finds the end zone in Week 11 win
items.desc: Mitchell Evans caught all five of his targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: Evans found the end zone on a 23-yard reception in the first quarter to open the scoring for the Panthers. This marked the first touchdown reception of the season for Evans. Evans and the Panthers will take on Tampa Bay in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tommy Tremble hauls in one pass in Week 11
items.desc: Tommy Tremble caught his lone target for 18 yards in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: Tremble was the least targeted tight end on the offense Sunday. The team could have elected to work him back in slowly in his return from a knee injury that limited him in practice during the week. Tremble and the Panthers will take on Tampa Bay in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Darren Waller hauls in three passes in Week 11
items.desc: Darren Waller caught all three of his targets for 42 yards in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: Waller, Tommy Tremble, and Mitchell Evans all got into the action in an impressive offensive performance by the Panthers. Waller and the Panthers will take on the Buccaneers in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jalen Coker hauls in four passes in Week 11 win
items.desc: Jalen Coker caught 4-of-7 targets for 47 yards in a 35-33 loss to the Ravens.
items.impact: Coker needed a bounce back performance after failing to record a catch last week. He did leave the game late and is now in the concussion protocol. He will need to clear the protocol before being able to suit up against the Buccaneers in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tetairoa McMillan finds the end zone in Week 11 win
items.desc: Tetairoa McMillan caught 6-of-9 targets for 71 yards and one touchdown in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: McMillan found the end zone on a seven yard reception in the second quarter, marking his fourth touchdown of the season. McMilan and the Panthers will take on Tampa Bay in a divisional matchup in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Trevor Etienne sees seven touches in Week 11 win
items.desc: Trevor Etienne rushed for 29 yards on six carries in a 35-33 win over the Ravens. He caught his lone target for seven yards.
items.impact: Etienne continues to serve as the backup behind Chuba Hubbard. He is not currently seeing enough touches to be fantasy viable heading into Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chuba Hubbard hits pay dirt twice in Week 11
items.desc: Chuba Hubbard rushed for 120 yards and two touchdowns on 27 carries in a 35-33 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: Hubbard found the end zone on rushes from one and 18 yards out in the seesaw win over the Ravens. This marks the second straight game Hubbard has seen 27 carries and scored two touchdowns. Hubbard and the Panthers will take on Tampa Bay in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cade Otton catches one pass in Week 11
items.desc: Cade Otton caught one of his three targets for eight yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
items.impact: Otton has underwhelmed in the Tampa Bay offense of late, finishing under 30 receiving yards in each of his last six games. The tight end will look to get back on track against the Carolina Panthers in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Bryce Young tosses a pair of touchdowns in Week 11 win
items.desc: Bryce Young completed 22-of-30 pass attempts for 254 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception. He rushed for negative two yards on two carries.
items.impact: Young turned in a solid performance after failing to throw a touchdown pass a week ago. Young connected on touchdown passes to Tetairoa McMillan and Mitchell Evans to help pace the Panthers to their fifth victory of the season. They will take on Tampa Bay in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tez Johnson catches two passes in Week 11
items.desc: Tez Johnson caught two of his three targets for 17 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
items.impact: Johnson has struggled to make an impact in the Tampa Bay offense of late, finishing with less than 35 receiving yards in four of his last five contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Carolina Panthers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ted Hurst III catches two touchdowns in Week 11 loss to Lions
items.desc: Ted Hurst III hauled in five of his team-high seven targets for 56 yards and two touchdowns in the Buccaneers' 31-21 Week 11 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Hurst III took advantage of a larger role in the Tampa Bay passing attack, finishing with 40 or more receiving yards for the second time in his last five contests. The speedy wideout remains difficult to trust as one of many inconsistent options on offense to this point, with a Week 12 matchup against the Carolina Panthers up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ravens D/ST struggles in Week 11 loss
items.desc: The Ravens D/ST allowed 254 passing yards, 147 rushing yards, and 35 points in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
items.impact: The Ravens and Panthers traded blows and lead changes all game. The Ravens' defense tallied three sacks, including one for a safety,  and one interception in the loss. The special teams unit did account for an 86-yard kickoff return touchdown in the second quarter. They will face a tough test with C.J. Stroud and the Texans up next in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Riley Patterson perfect in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Riley Patterson connected on his lone field goal attempt and 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
items.impact: Patterson's lone field goal was a 28-yard attempt in the first quarter. The 27-year-old is 3-for-3 on field goal attempts in his two games since joining the Ravens.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mark Andrews hauls in two passes in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Mark Andrews caught 2-of-3 targets for 14 yards in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
items.impact: Andrews saw his target total drop from eight in the loss Monday to just three Sunday. The veteran tight end will look to bounce back against Houston in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Bauer Sharp sees one target in Week 11
items.desc: Bauer Sharp failed to catch his only target in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
items.impact: Sharp has seen minimal involvement in the Tampa Bay offense, logging one target or less in each of his last nine contests. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Carolina Panthers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Rashod Bateman finds the end zone in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Rashod Bateman caught 2-of-6 targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
items.impact: Bateman found the end zone on a 52-yard touchdown pass from Jacoby Brissett early in the first quarter. It ended a long touchdown drought for Bateman, marking his first touchdown reception since Week 2. Bateman and the Ravens will take on the Texans in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane not targeted in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane did not record a target in a 35-33 loss to Carolina.
items.impact: Lane was targeted 11 times in Monday's loss to the Chargers, but did not have a ball thrown his way in the loss Sunday. Fantasy managers may need to consider sitting Lane until his target share becomes clear and more consistent.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Buccaneers D/ST struggles in Week 11
items.desc: The Buccaneers D/ST registered one sack while failing to force any turnovers in a 31-21 loss to the Detroit Lions in Week 11.
items.impact: The defense was unable to come up with stops when it mattered, allowing multiple touchdowns on the ground and through the air in the loss. The unit will look to be more disruptive in Week 12 against the Carolina Panthers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chase McLaughlin perfect in Week 11
items.desc: Chase McLaughlin converted all three of his extra point attempts to finish with three points in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
items.impact: McLaughlin fell back to earth, finishing with less than six points for the first time in six contests. The kicker will look to return to his impactful form in a Week 12 divisional contest against the Carolina Panthers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Justice Hill finds the end zone in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Justice Hill rushed for 69 yards and a touchdown on six carries in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers. He caught 4-of-5 targets for 27 yards.
items.impact: Hill found the end zone on a 19 yard rush in late in the second quarter. Derrick Henry was being evaluated for a concussion late in the game, so Hill could be in line for more work in Week 12 if Henry is unable to clear the protocol in time to play against Houston.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jacoby Brissett tosses game ending INT in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Jacoby Brissett completed 24-of-37 pass attempts for 276 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers. He added seven rushing yards on two attempts.
items.impact: Brissett was solid in his second start for Baltimore, but tossed up a bad pass late in the fourth quarter to seal the win for the Panthers. The veteran connected with Rashod Bateman on a 52-yard touchdown reception early in the first quarter. The Ravens and Brissett will look to bounce back in a Week 12 matchup with Houston.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chiefs D/ST allows seven points in Week 11 win
items.desc: The Chiefs D/ST allowed 155 passing yards, 75 rushing yards, and seven points in a 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: The Chiefs' defense tallied three sacks but failed to force a turnover in the win. The defense will face a much tougher test when they take on Buffalo in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Harrison Butker perfect in Week 11 win
items.desc: Harrison Butker connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 34-7 win over Arizona.
items.impact: Butker connected on field goals from 40 and 44 yards out to help pace the Chiefs to a win. Butker needed a strong performance in what has been a trying season for the veteran. The Chiefs and Butker will take on the Bills in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Noah Gray hauls in three passes in Week 11
items.desc: Noah Gray caught 3-of-5 targets for 21 yards in a 34-7 win over Arizona.
items.impact: Gray continues to be used sparingly as the backup to Travis Kelce. Gray did exit the game early with a rib injury, which is something to monitor considering the Chiefs play the Bills on Thursday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Travis Kelce finds the end zone twice in Week 11 win
items.desc: Travis Kelce caught 6-of-7 targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in a 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Kelce scored on touchdown receptions of eight and 22 yards in the first half. This ended a long touchdown drought for the veteran, who had not scored since Week 3. Kelce and the Chiefs will take on the Bills in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Cyrus Allen hauls in two passes in Week 11
items.desc: Cyrus Allen caught 2-of-4 targets for 41 yards in a 34-7 win over Arizona.
items.impact: Allen continues to be used sparingly in the Chiefs' offense, with his four targets tying a season high. Fantasy managers can leave him out of their lineups heading into a Week 12 matchup with the Bills.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Xavier Worthy hits pay dirt in Week 11
items.desc: Xavier Worthy caught 2-of-4 targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in a 34-7 win over Arizona.
items.impact: Worthy hauled in a 18-yard touchdown pass in the fourth quarter to put the finishing touches on the win Sunday. This marked Worthy's first touchdown reception since Week 2. Worthy will look to continue to build on this momentum in a Week 12 matchup with Buffalo.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Josh Downs hauls in four passes in Week 11
items.desc: Josh Downs caught 4-of-5 targets for 59 yards in a 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Downs has posted similar lines in his first two outings with the Chiefs, logging five targets in each game. As he continues to become for comfortable in the offense, fantasy managers should expect Downs to earn more targets from Patrick Mahomes.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Rashee Rice hauls in six passes in Week 11
items.desc: Rashee Rice caught 6-of-6 targets for 53 yards in a 34-7 win over Arizona.
items.impact: Rice tied Travis Kelce for the team lead in receptions in the win Sunday. Rice continues to see a consistent target share, logging at least six in each of his last four games. Rice and the Chiefs will take on the Bills in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Emmett Johnson finds the end zone in Week 11 win
items.desc: Emmett Johnson rushed for 105 yards and a touchdown on 23 carries in a 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Johnson led the Chiefs' backfield with Kenneth Walker inactive again due to injury. The Chiefs have clearly trusted Johnson in his two starts, providing the rookie with 20+ carries in each outing. If Walker returns in Week 12, Johnson remains an extremely strong handcuff for fantasy managers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II tosses three touchdowns in Week 11 win
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II completed 27-of-39 passes for 324 yards and three touchdowns in a 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
items.impact: Mahomes has now eclipses 300+ yards passing in three of his last four games and has not thrown an interception in four straight games. Mahomes connected with Xaiver Worthy and Travis Kelce twice to account for his three passing touchdowns. The Chiefs will have a short week as they take on the Bills on Thursday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Cardinals D/ST allows 34 points in Week 11 loss
items.desc: The Cardinals D/ST allowed 324 passing yards, 118 rushing yards, and 34 points in a 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: The Cardinals' defense tallied one sack but failed to force a turnover in the loss. The defense allowed the Chiefs' offense to score at will and rest some of their starters in the fourth quarter. They will look to bounce back against the Commanders in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chad Ryland perfect on lone kick in Week 11
items.desc: Chad Ryland connected on his lone extra point attempt in a 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Ryland connected on his lone extra point attempt after a second quarter touchdown by Simi Fehoko. The Cardinals' offense continues to struggle, which limits Ryland's opportunities.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Trey McBride hauls in nine passes in Week 11
items.desc: Trey McBride caught 9-of-14 targets for 54 yards in a 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: McBride led the team in targets and receptions, which should not come as a surprise with the numerous injuries to the Cardinals' wide receiver group. McBride will remain the top pass catching option for the Cardinals in a Week 12 matchup with the Commanders.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Simi Fehoko finds the end zone in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Simi Fehoko caught 1-of-5 targets for two yards and a touchdown in a 34-7 loss to the Chiefs. He also added seven rushing yards on three attempts.
items.impact: Fehoko accounted for the lone touchdown on a two-yard reception in the second quarter. The five targets are a new season high for Fehoko, but he has not recorded more than one reception in a game this season. Fehoko and the Cardinals will take on the Commanders in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Bam Knight tallies eight touches in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Bam Knight rushes for 35 yards on seven attempts in a 34-7 loss to the Chiefs. He caught his lone target for 10 yards.
items.impact: Knight tied Tyler Alleiger for the same number of carries, but outgained him on the ground. His seven rushing attempts are the most in a game for Knight since he saw 15 carries against the Rams in Week 6. Knight and the Cardinals will take on the Commanders in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyler Allgeier quiet in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Tyler Allgeier rushed for 23 yards on seven carries in a 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
items.impact: Allgeier did not factor into the passing attack and was outgained on the ground by Bam Knight on the same number of rushing attempts. This marked the first time that Allgeier did not register a target in a game this season. The 26-year-old will look to bounce back against the Commanders in Week 12.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Josh Johnson tosses one touchdown in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Josh Johnson completed 18-of-31 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown in a 34-7 loss to the Chiefs. He also added five rushing yards on two carries.
items.impact: Johnson was making his first start in place of the injured Carson Beck. The veteran journeyman did enough to manage the offense, but he could only manage one touchdown drive in a route by the Chiefs. The Cardinals will take on the Commanders in Week 12.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Derrick Henry being evaluated for concussion
items.desc: Derrick Henry is being evaluated for a concussion by the Baltimore Ravens according to Mike Garafolo.
items.impact: Henry exited late in the fourth quarter after landing hard in the end zone, rushing 13 times for 94 yards and one touchdown prior to exiting. Justice Hill will take over in the backfield for head coach Jesse Minter against the Panthers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Juwan Johnson (hamstring) questionable to return
items.desc: Saints TE Juwan Johnson (hamstring) is questionable to return against Chicago.
items.impact: Johnson had not recorded a reception on just one target prior to exiting the game. Noah Fant should see an uptick in playing time for the remainder of the game if Johnson cannot return.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (knee) questionable to return
items.desc: Ravens DE Trey Hendrickson (knee) is questionable to return Sunday.
items.impact: Hendrickson's absence will leave the Ravens short a pass rusher in what has been a high scoring affair against the Panthers. Hendrickson had tallied one quarterback hit and one pass defensed prior to exiting with the injury.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: DK Metcalf ejected Sunday
items.desc: Steelers WR DK Metcalf has been ejected from Sunday's game due to unsportsmanlike conduct.
items.impact: Metcalf was involved in a few different issues on the field Sunday, but was ejected after his second personal foul. He finished the game with one reception for two yards on four targets. Metcalf could face a suspension from the league after they review what caused the second personal foul penalty.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) inactive for Week 11
items.desc: Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) is officially inactive for Week 11 for the Las Vegas Raiders against the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Bowers will not suit up after entering the weekend with a questionable designation, leaving the Las Vegas passing attack without the dynamic pass-catcher. Michael Mayer will slide into the TE1 role against a tough Broncos defense Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ladd McConkey (back) officially active for Week 11
items.desc: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (back) is officially active for a Week 11 matchup with the Jets.
items.impact: McConkey was expected to test out his injured back in pregame warmups and was cleared to play. McConkey will provide Justin Herbert with his top pass catching option as they look for their second win of the season.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: DJ Moore (knee) questionable to return Sunday
items.desc: DJ Moore (knee) is questionable to return for the Buffalo Bills Sunday according to Mike Garafolo.
items.impact: Moore was hurt late in the second quarter, hauling in all six of his targets for 58 yards and one touchdown prior to exiting.
